skill.summary: 企业舆情监测与风险预警技能。基于 FEEDAX API 查询特定上市公司的新闻资讯和舆情动态，支持情感分析（正面/负面/中性）、舆情热度评估、行业分类和关联公司识别。 使用场景：用户查询特定公司新闻、监测企业舆情风险、分析公司口碑、研究上市公司动态、追踪企业负面事件、评估投资风险、了解行业竞争格局等。 触发示例：...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of company-information (企业舆情监测与风险预警) skill.

- Enables monitoring and early warning for public opinion on listed companies via FEEDAX API.
- Supports keyword/company name queries, sentiment analysis (positive/negative/neutral), news heat evaluation, industry classification, and related company recognition.
- Returns multi-dimensional insights including core fields: title, summary, sentiment, source, stock info, industry, company/aliases, heat score, and event tags.
- Provides both quick (top 5 results in chat) and complete (CSV, MD export) data access for company news and sentiment.
- Includes CLI script for advanced search and filtering; detailed API error handling and configuration guidance.
